title: Colored Markov-Modulated Brownian Motion for Preemptive Workload Stacks
summary: We develop a colored Markov-modulated Brownian motion model for diffusion-scale systems in which newly created work preempts the active layer, occupies the top of an ordered stack, and must deplete before suspended work resumes. Such preemption arises whenever new work interrupts whatever is currently active, as in last-come, first-served queues and interrupt-driven scheduling, with diffusive dynamics appropriate when the processing rate itself fluctuates randomly.
